skill.name: Image Component Optimization
skill.description: Optimize image delivery by implementing lazy loading and automatic device-based resizing. Use when rendering images in responsive web layouts to reduce initial page load time and improve performance.
skill.skill_body: Apply the Image Component to abstract image optimization complexity. The component lazy-loads images on viewport entry and automatically resizes based on device screen size. Ensure images are wrapped with the Image Component rather than native tags to enable these optimizations. ## Objective optimize_image_delivery ## Applicable Signals - rendering images in responsive web layouts - need to reduce initial page load time - multiple images on a single page - images of varying sizes across device breakpoints ## Contraindications - static images with fixed dimensions that do not require responsiveness - images already served from CDN with built-in optimization - critical above-the-fold images where lazy loading would delay visibility ## Intervention Moves - Replace native elements with Image Component - Configure device-based sizing rules - Verify lazy-load behavior on viewport entry ## Workflow Steps - Identify images in the layout that would benefit from lazy loading and responsive resizing - Replace native tags with Image Component - Configure device-based sizing parameters - Test lazy-load behavior and responsive resizing across target devices ## Constraints - Image Component must be used instead of native tags to enable optimization - Device size detection must be available in the rendering environment ## Cautions - Lazy loading may delay image visibility; consider eager loading for critical above-the-fold images - Automatic resizing requires device size context; verify breakpoint configuration matches design requirements ## Output Contract - Images load lazily on viewport entry - Image dimensions adapt to device screen size without layout shift - Page load time is reduced compared to native implementation
